<TITLE>EX-10.6</TITLE>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 10.6 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">FORM OF VERSIGENT PLC </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">EXECUTIVE SEVERANCE PLAN </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Plan, effective as of April XX, 2026 (the &#8220; Effective Date &#8221;), is for the benefit of Eligible Executives on the terms and conditions
hereinafter stated. This Plan, as set forth herein, is intended to provide a threshold level of certain economic benefits to Eligible Executives, in the event of certain terminations of employment, for a period of time while the terminated Eligible
Executives make the transition to new employment. This Plan, as a &#8220;severance pay arrangement&#8221; within the meaning of Section&nbsp;3(2) (B)(i) of ERISA, is intended to be excepted from the definitions of &#8220;employee pension benefit
plan&#8221; and &#8220;pension plan&#8221; set forth under Section&nbsp;3(2) of ERISA, and is intended to meet the descriptive requirements of a plan constituting a &#8220;severance pay plan&#8221; within the meaning of regulations published by the
Secretary of Labor at Title 29, Code of Federal Regulations &#167; <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">2510.3-2(b).</FONT> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1. <B>DEFINITIONS.</B> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">As used in this Plan: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.1 &#8220; Affiliate &#8221; means
(a)&nbsp;any entity that, directly or indirectly, is controlled by the Company, (b)&nbsp;any entity in which the Company, directly or indirectly, has a significant equity interest, in each case as determined by the Compensation Committee and
(c)&nbsp;any other entity that the Compensation Committee determines should be treated as an &#8220;Affiliate.&#8221; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.2 &#8220; Base Salary &#8221;
means, with respect to an Eligible Executive, the Eligible Executive&#8217;s annual base salary rate as of the Separation Date, and shall in all cases exclude any bonus, overtime, commission, profit-sharing or similar payments and any short-term or
long-term incentives, stock-based compensation, benefits, perquisites, expense reimbursements, allowances or similar forms of compensation. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.3 &#8220;
Board &#8221; means the board of directors of the Company. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.4 &#8220; Cause &#8221; means, for purposes of a termination of an Eligible
Executive&#8217;s employment with the Company and its Affiliates, such Eligible Executive&#8217;s: (a)&nbsp;indictment for any crime (i)&nbsp;constituting a felony, or (ii)&nbsp;that has, or could reasonably be expected to result in, an adverse
impact on the performance of the Eligible Executive&#8217;s duties to the Company or a Subsidiary, or otherwise has, or could reasonably be expected to result in, an adverse impact to the business or reputation of the Company or a Subsidiary;
(b)&nbsp;having been the subject of any order, judicial or administrative, obtained or issued by the Securities and Exchange Commission for any securities violation involving fraud, including, for example, any such order consented to by the Eligible
Executive in which findings of facts or any legal conclusions establishing liability </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
are neither admitted nor denied; (c)&nbsp;conduct, in connection with his or her employment or service, that is not taken in good faith and has, or could reasonably be expected to result in,
material injury to the business or reputation of the Company or a Subsidiary or that are materially inimical to the best interests of the Company or a Subsidiary; (d)&nbsp;willful violation of the Company&#8217;s Code of Conduct or other material
policies set forth in the manuals or statements of policy of the Company; (e)&nbsp;willful neglect in the performance of the Eligible Executive&#8217;s duties for the Company or willful or repeated failure or refusal to perform such duties; or
(f)&nbsp;material breach of any applicable employment agreement. The occurrence of any such event that is susceptible to cure or remedy shall not constitute Cause if such Eligible Executive cures or remedies such event within 30 days after the
Company provides notice to such Eligible Executive. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.5 &#8220; Change in Control &#8221; shall have the meaning provided for such term in the Versigent
Executive Change in Control Severance Plan, as it may be amended from time to time. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.6 &#8220; COBRA &#8221; means the Consolidated Omnibus Budget
Reconciliation Act of 1985, as amended from time to time. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.7 &#8220; Code &#8221; means the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as it may be amended from
time to time, including, without limitation, any rules and regulations promulgated thereunder, along with Treasury and Internal Revenue Service interpretations thereof. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.8 &#8220; Common Stock &#8221; means the Ordinary Shares, $0.01 par value per share, of the Company or any security into which such Ordinary Shares may be
changed by reason of any transaction or similar event. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.9 &#8220; Company &#8221; means Versigent PLC, a Jersey public limited company, or its
successor. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.10 &#8220; Compensation Committee &#8221; means the Compensation and Human Resources Committee of the Board, or its successor. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.11 &#8220; Continuation Period &#8221; means, as applicable, the following period of time that applies to an Eligible Executive in connection with a
Severance: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.12 &#8220; Continuous Service &#8221; is measured from an Employee&#8217;s most recent hire date to the
last day of employment, in each case with respect to the Employer, and is expressed as completed years. A leave of absence does not interrupt an Employee&#8217;s Continuous Service, provided the Employee returns to work with the Employer at the end
of the leave; if the Employee does not so return to work, service will be counted through the last day worked before the leave began. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.13 Disability
&#8221; means (a)&nbsp;a permanent and total disability that entitles the Eligible Executive to disability income payments under any long-term disability plan or policy provided by or on behalf of the Company under which the Eligible Executive is
covered, as such plan or policy is then in effect, or (b)&nbsp;if such Eligible Executive is not covered under a long-term disability plan or policy provided by or on behalf of the Company at such time for whatever reason, then a &#8220;permanent
and total disability&#8221; as defined in Section&nbsp;22(e)(3) of the Code and, in this case, the existence of any such Disability will be certified by a physician acceptable to the Company. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.14 &#8220; Eligible Executive &#8221; means an Officer or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Officer</FONT> (a)&nbsp;designated from time to time to any
pay grade structure used to define executive positions, as applicable, or who may otherwise be designated as an Eligible Executive from time to time by the Compensation Committee or its designee (and such designation has not as of the Separation
Date been withdrawn or otherwise revoked, as applicable) and (b)&nbsp;who accepts participation herein in such manner as shall be prescribed by the Company; provided , however , that (c)&nbsp;notwithstanding anything in this Plan to the contrary,
&#8220; Eligible Executive &#8221; shall not include any Officer or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Officer</FONT> who, prior to the Effective Date, made an irrevocable election to receive payments or benefits under a supplemental executive
retirement program sponsored by the Company, its predecessors or their Affiliates in lieu of certain separation benefits. The Compensation Committee may require as a condition of participation in this Plan that an Eligible Executive execute a
participation agreement pursuant to which the Eligible Executive agrees to the terms of his or her participation set forth in this Plan. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.15 &#8220;
Employee &#8221; means (a)&nbsp;each employee of the Employer who (i)&nbsp;works full-time, including flex service employees, and (ii)&nbsp;is compensated as a regular or flexible service employee, but does not mean (b)(i) part-time and temporary
employees, excluding flex service employees, (ii)&nbsp;supplemental, contract or agency employees (that is, employees whose employment, whether part-time or full-time, is classified by the Company as supplemental or temporary in nature, and in any
event not generally intended to exceed 18 months in duration), (iii) independent contractors (regardless of whether the individual is classified as an employee by any federal, state or local agency or any court of competent jurisdiction), (iv)
employees who have elected to be placed on administrative leave pursuant to a written agreement between the employee and the Employer, (v)&nbsp;leased employees (as defined in Section&nbsp;414 of the Code,
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(vi)&nbsp;non-employee</FONT> members of the Board, and (vii)&nbsp;any <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Officer</FONT> (x)&nbsp;whose Home Country is not the United States and (y)&nbsp;who is entitled to receive
statutory benefits in the event of a Qualifying Separation. </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.16 &#8220; Employer &#8221; means, with respect to an Eligible Executive, the Subsidiary that employs the
Eligible Executive, or any successor thereto. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.17 &#8220; Employment Agreement &#8221; means any employment, severance, consulting or similar agreement
(including any offer letter) between the Company or any of its Affiliates and an Eligible Executive. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.18 &#8220; ERISA &#8221; means the Employee
Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, as amended. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.19 &#8220; Exchange Act &#8221; means the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, and the
rules and regulations thereunder, as such law, rules and regulations may be amended from time to time. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.20 &#8220; Good Reason &#8221; means: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) with respect to any Eligible Executive, &#8220;good reason&#8221; as defined in the Eligible Executive&#8217;s Employment Agreement, if any; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) if not so defined, the occurrence of any one or more of the following events: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) a material diminution in the Eligible Executive&#8217;s Base Salary; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) a material diminution in the Eligible Executive&#8217;s authority, duties, or responsibilities; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) a relocation of the Eligible Executive&#8217;s principal place of employment more than 50 miles from its location; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iv) any other action or inaction that constitutes a material breach by the Company of the Eligible Executive&#8217;s Employment Agreement, if any; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">in each case, without the Eligible Executive&#8217;s consent. An Eligible Executive must provide notice to the Company of the existence of any one or more of
the conditions described in (i)&nbsp;through (iv) above within 60 days of the initial existence of the condition, upon the notice of which the Company will have a period of 30 days during which it may remedy the condition before the condition gives
rise to Good Reason. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.21 &#8220; <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Officer</FONT> &#8221; means any Employee of the Employer who is not an Officer.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.22 &#8220; Home Country &#8221; means, for Eligible Executives who are not expatriates, the country in which the Eligible Executive&#8217;s employment
is based. For expatriate employees, the Home Country means the country in which the Eligible Executive was last employed prior to the international assignment and the country to which the Eligible Executive will most likely return upon the
completion of the assignment. </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.23 &#8220; Officer &#8221; means any Employee of the Employer who is an elected officer of the Company.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.24 &#8220; Person &#8221; means any &#8220;person&#8221; as such term is used for purposes of Section&nbsp;13(d) or 14(d) of the Exchange Act. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.25 &#8220; Plan &#8221; means this Versigent Executive Severance Plan, as set forth herein, as it may be amended from time to time. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.26 Plan Administrator &#8221; means the Compensation Committee or such subcommittee or person or persons appointed from time to time by the Compensation
Committee to administer this Plan, which appointment may be revoked at any time by the Compensation Committee. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.27 &#8220; Protection Period &#8221;
means either (a)&nbsp;the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">two-year</FONT> period following a Change in Control or (b)&nbsp;only if an Officer experiences an involuntary termination of his or her employment by the Employer without Cause (other than
by reason of death or Disability) between the signing date of the merger or other applicable transaction document pursuant to which a Change in Control described in subsections (a), (c) or (d)&nbsp;of the definition of Change in Control occurs and
the earlier of the date of the Change in Control or the date such merger or transaction agreement terminates (the &#8220; <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Pre-Change</FONT> in Control Period &#8221;), and such termination occurs at the request of
any party involved in the Change in Control, the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Pre-Change</FONT> in Control Period (in which case the Officer&#8217;s applicable Separation Date shall be deemed to be the date of the Change in Control). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.28 &#8220; Qualifying Separation &#8221; means: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) For any
Officer, (i)&nbsp;an involuntary termination of the Officer&#8217;s employment by the Employer without Cause (other than by reason of death or Disability) other than during the Protection Period, or (ii)&nbsp;a voluntary termination of the
Officer&#8217;s employment for Good Reason other than during the Protection Period; and </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) For any <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Officer,</FONT>
an involuntary termination of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Officer&#8217;s</FONT> employment by the Employer without Cause (other than by reason of death or Disability); provided , however , that </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) A Qualifying Separation shall not occur by reason of the divestiture of a facility, sale of a business or business unit, or the outsourcing of a business
activity with which an Eligible Executive is affiliated, if the Eligible Executive is offered comparable employment with a Base Salary and annual cash incentive award opportunity at least equal in value to that in effect immediately prior to such
transfer of employment by the entity that acquires such facility, business or business unit or that succeeds to such outsourced business activity. </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.29 &#8220; Section&nbsp;409A &#8221; means Section&nbsp;409A of the Code, and the rules, regulations and
guidance promulgated thereunder by the U.S. Department of the Treasury or the U.S. Internal Revenue Service </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.30 &#8220; Separation Date &#8221; means,
with respect to an Eligible Executive, the date on which the Eligible Executive incurs a Qualifying Separation. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1.31 &#8220; Subsidiary &#8221; means a
corporation, company or other entity (a)&nbsp;more than 50% of whose outstanding shares or securities (representing the right to vote for the election of directors or other managing authority) are, or (b)&nbsp;which does not have outstanding shares
or securities (as may be the case in a partnership, limited liability company, joint venture or unincorporated association), but more than 50% of whose ownership interest representing the right generally to make decisions for such other entity is,
now or hereafter, owned or controlled, directly or indirectly, by the Company. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2. <B><U>SEVERANCE PAYMENTS AND BENEFITS.</U></B> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.1 General . If an Eligible Executive incurs a Qualifying Separation, and as long as the Eligible Executive is not then entitled to receive severance
payments or benefits under any Employment Agreement, any change in control severance plan, program or arrangement or any other severance arrangement with the Company or its Affiliates (other than as described in Section&nbsp;2.4 below) as a result
of the Qualifying Separation, then such Eligible Executive shall be entitled to receive severance payments and benefits pursuant to the applicable provisions of this Section&nbsp;2. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.2 Salary-Based Payments . Each Eligible Executive who incurs a Qualifying Separation shall be entitled to an aggregate cash severance payment, payable
(subject to Section&nbsp;7 of this Plan) in substantially equal <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">bi-monthly</FONT> installments starting on the second payroll date following the expiration of the revocation period for the Release under
Section&nbsp;2.5 but no later than on the 90th day following the Separation Date (such date the &#8220; Payment Date &#8221;) in an amount as reflected in the following table: </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

only until the Eligible Executive is employed by another employer subsequent to the Qualifying Separation and any cash severance payments that remain unpaid as of the Eligible Employee&#8217;s date of hire with a new employer will be forfeited. The
Eligible Executive shall give Notice as required by Section&nbsp;5.7 to the Company of any such employment and health benefits. The first </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
installment of cash severance payments made pursuant to this Section&nbsp;2.2 shall include any installments that would have been made during the period from the Separation Date through the
actual first payment date if the revocation period for the Release under Section&nbsp;2.5 had expired on the Separation Date and payments had started immediately after such expiration. Further, any cash severance payments described in this
Section&nbsp;2.2 shall be reduced by any statutory benefits that may be owed to any such Eligible Executive to the extent such reduction would not result in any additional taxes or early income inclusion under Section&nbsp;409A of the Code. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.3 Health Benefits. If an Eligible Executive incurs a Qualifying Separation and elects COBRA coverage, the Company shall arrange for such coverage at its
expense; provided , however , that the Eligible Executive shall pay to the Company or its designee a monthly cash payment equal to the premium active employees would pay for the same coverage, beginning in the month following the month in which the
Separation Date occurs and continuing until the earlier of (a)&nbsp;the end of the Continuation Period, or (b)&nbsp;the date on which the Eligible Executive becomes eligible for medical or dental coverage as the case may be from a third party (the
&#8220; Subsidized COBRA Period &#8221;). If the Eligible Executive becomes eligible for medical or dental coverage from a third party, the Eligible Executive shall report to the Company such coverage immediately. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.4 Impact of Qualifying Separation on Equity Awards or Annual Cash Incentive Award Opportunity . In the case of each Eligible Executive who incurs a
Qualifying Separation, the provisions of the applicable annual cash incentive, long-term incentive and equity (or equity-based) award agreements and plans and programs, or any other documents or arrangements applicable at such time that provide for
the treatment of such annual cash incentive, long-term incentive and equity (or equity-based) awards in connection with or after the Qualifying Separation, will govern the treatment of all annual cash incentive, long-term incentive and equity (or
equity-based) awards held by the Eligible Executive, as applicable, as of the Separation Date. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.5 Release . Notwithstanding the foregoing, as a
condition to the payment or receipt of any payment or benefit pursuant to the applicable provision of this Section&nbsp;2 , each Eligible Executive shall be required to execute and deliver, before the 60th day following the Eligible
Executive&#8217;s Separation Date, an effective general waiver and release of claims agreement in favor of the Company and its Subsidiaries and Affiliates, in the form provided by the Company (&#8220; Release &#8221;), and any applicable revocation
period must have expired during such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">60-day</FONT> period without the Eligible Executive revoking such Release. To the extent an Eligible Executive is required to sign a release of claims agreement to receive any
payment under Section&nbsp;2 deemed to be &#8220;deferred compensation&#8221; for purposes of Section&nbsp;409A, and the period of time from the Eligible Employee&#8217;s Separation Date to the second payroll date after the 60th day following the
Eligible Employee&#8217;s Separation Date (the &#8220; Release Period &#8221;) starts in one calendar year </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
and ends in the following calendar year, such payments that would otherwise be made in the first calendar year will be made in the second calendar year, notwithstanding when the release of claims
is executed and becomes irrevocable, and the first payment made will include any payments that would have been made during the period from the Separation Date through the actual first payment date if the revocation period for the Release had expired
on the Separation Date and payments had started immediately after such expiration. Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary, the Release Period will not exceed 90 days. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2.6 No Severance Payments or Benefits Under Certain Circumstances . Notwithstanding anything in this Plan to the contrary, no severance payments or benefits
will be paid or provided to an Eligible Executive under this Plan in the event that the Eligible Executive: (a)&nbsp;fails to perform his or her assigned duties in a manner satisfactory to the Company through the Separation Date; (b)&nbsp;fails to
cooperate with the Company, those acting on its behalf, or governmental authorities in connection with any special investigation conducted by the Company, or any government investigation; (c)&nbsp;fails or refuses to return all the Company&#8217;s
or its Subsidiaries&#8217; property in the Eligible Executive&#8217;s possession or fails to settle all expenses and other financial obligations; (d)&nbsp;resigns or otherwise voluntarily terminates his or her employment with the applicable Employer
(including retirement) for any reason (other than by an Officer as provided for in Section&nbsp;1.27(a)(ii) ); (e) is temporarily <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">laid-off</FONT> or furloughed; (f)&nbsp;is offered a reasonably comparable position
within the Company or any of its Subsidiaries in lieu of termination, but fails or refuses to reasonably accept it; (g)&nbsp;is terminated in connection with the outsourcing of operational functions, and the Eligible Executive is offered a
reasonably comparable position by the outsourcing vendor; or (h)&nbsp;is terminated for failure to return to work following a leave of absence when directed by the Employer consistent with the rules or policies of the Employer. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B></B>3.<B> <U>PLAN ADMINISTRATION</U>. </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.1 The Plan
Administrator shall administer this Plan and may interpret this Plan, prescribe, amend and rescind rules and regulations under this Plan and make all other determinations necessary or advisable for the administration of this Plan, subject to all of
the provisions of this Plan. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.2 The Plan Administrator may delegate any of its duties hereunder to such person or persons from time to time as it may
designate. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3.3 The Plan Administrator is empowered, on behalf of this Plan, to engage accountants, legal counsel and such other personnel as it deems
necessary or advisable to assist it in the performance of its duties under this Plan. The functions of any such persons engaged by the Plan Administrator shall be limited to the specified services and duties for which they are engaged, and such
persons shall have no other duties, obligations or responsibilities under this Plan. Such persons shall exercise no discretionary authority or discretionary control respecting the management of this Plan. All reasonable expenses thereof shall be
borne by the Company. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4. <B><U>PLAN MODIFICATION OR TERMINATION.</U></B> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, this Plan may be amended or terminated by the Board or the Compensation Committee at any time with respect to
some or all Eligible Executives, and this Plan may be amended at any time and from time to time to comply with any recapture or &#8220;clawback&#8221; policy of the Company adopted by the Board to comply with Section&nbsp;10D of the Securities
Exchange Act of 1934 and any applicable rules or regulations promulgated by the Securities and Exchange Commission or any national securities exchange or national securities association on which the Common Stock may be traded, as determined by the
Plan Administrator. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5. <B><U>GENERAL PROVISIONS.</U></B> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.1 Subject to Section&nbsp;2, if the Company or any Subsidiary or Affiliate is obligated by law or by contract to pay severance pay, a termination indemnity,
notice pay, or the like, or if the Company or any Subsidiary or Affiliate is obligated by law to provide advance notice of separation to an Eligible Executive (a &#8220; Notice Period &#8221;), then any payments to the Eligible Executive pursuant to
Section&nbsp;2 shall be reduced by the amount of any such severance pay, termination indemnity, notice pay or the like, as applicable, and by the amount of any compensation received during any Notice Period except to the extent such reduction would
be a violation of Section&nbsp;409A. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.2 Neither the establishment of this Plan, nor any modification thereof, nor the creation of any fund, trust or
account, nor the payment of any benefits, shall be construed as giving any Eligible Executive, or any person whomsoever, the right to be retained in the service of the Company or any Subsidiary or Affiliate, and all Eligible Executives shall remain
subject to discharge to the same extent as if this Plan had never been adopted. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.3 If any provision of this Plan shall be held invalid or unenforceable,
such invalidity or unenforceability shall not affect any other provisions hereof, and this Plan shall be construed and enforced as if such provisions had not been included. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.4 The headings and captions herein are provided for reference and convenience only, shall not be considered part of this Plan, and shall not be employed in
the construction of this Plan. Unless otherwise specified, all Section references herein are to this Plan. Any reference to a day or days herein refers to a calendar day or days unless otherwise stated. </P>

other rights under this Plan. Nothing contained in this Plan, and no action taken pursuant to this Plan, shall create or be construed to create a trust of any kind, or a fiduciary relationship, between the Company (or any of its Subsidiaries or
Affiliates) and any Eligible Executive or any other person. The rights of each Eligible Executive or each Eligible Executive&#8217;s estate to benefits under this Plan shall be solely those of an unsecured creditor of the Employer. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.7 All notices, requests and other communications under this Plan shall be in writing and shall be delivered in person (by courier or otherwise), mailed by

Plan, as it may be amended from time to time, any Employment Agreement, any other change in control severance plan, program or arrangement or any other severance arrangement with the Company or its Affiliates. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6. <B><U>SUCCESSORS; BINDING AGREEMENT.</U></B> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.1 Successors
of the Company . The Company shall require any successor (and its parent, if applicable) who shall purchase all or substantially all of the business and/or assets of the Company (whether direct or indirect, by purchase, merger, consolidation or
otherwise) to expressly assume and agree in writing to maintain this Plan in the same manner and to the same extent that the Company would be required to maintain it; provided that no such agreement shall be required if the successor (and its
parent, if applicable) shall be or remain so obligated by operation of law. As used in this Section&nbsp;6.1 , the &#8220;Company&#8221; shall mean the Company as hereinbefore defined and any successor to its business and/or assets as aforesaid
which assumes and agrees to maintain this Plan or which otherwise becomes bound by all the terms and provisions hereof by operation of law. </P>

<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.2 Eligible Executive&#8217;s Heirs, etc . This Plan shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by
each Eligible Executive&#8217;s personal or legal representatives, executors, administrators, heirs, distributees, devisees and legatees. If an Eligible Executive should die while any amounts or benefits would still be payable to the Eligible
Executive hereunder as if the Eligible Executive had continued to live, all such amounts and benefits, unless otherwise provided herein, shall be paid or provided in accordance with the terms hereof to the Eligible Executive&#8217;s designee or, if
there be no such designee, to the Eligible Executive&#8217;s estate. When a payment is due under this Plan to a severed Eligible Executive who is unable to care for his affairs, payment may be made directly to the Eligible Executive&#8217;s legal
guardian or personal representative. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.3 <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-alienation</FONT> . Except by will or intestacy as set forth in
Section&nbsp;6.2 , no right, benefit or interest of any Eligible Executive hereunder, shall be subject to anticipation, alienation, sale, assignment, encumbrance, charge, pledge, hypothecation, or setoff in respect of any claim, debt or obligation,
or to execution, attachment, levy or similar process, or assignment by operation of law. Any attempt, voluntary or involuntary, to effect any action specified in the immediately preceding sentence shall, to the full extent permitted by law, be null,
void and of no effect. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">7. <B><U>SECTION 409A.</U></B> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">7.1
General . Payments and benefits under this Plan are intended to comply with Section&nbsp;409A to the extent subject thereto, and, accordingly, to the maximum extent permitted, this Plan shall be interpreted and administered to be in compliance
therewith. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">7.2 Separation from Service . Notwithstanding anything contained herein to the contrary, to the extent required in order to avoid accelerated
taxation and/or tax penalties under Section&nbsp;409A, an Eligible Executive shall not be considered to have terminated employment with the Employer for purposes of this Plan and no payments shall be due to the Eligible Executive under this Plan
until the Eligible Executive would be considered to have incurred a &#8220;separation from service&#8221; from the Employer within the meaning of Section&nbsp;409A. </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">7.3 Delay for Specified Employees . Notwithstanding any provisions of this Plan to the contrary, if an
Eligible Executive is a &#8220;specified employee&#8221; (within the meaning of Section&nbsp;409A and determined pursuant to policies adopted by the Employer consistent with Section&nbsp;409A) at the time of the Eligible Executive&#8217;s separation
from service and if any portion of the payments or benefits to be received by the Eligible Executive upon separation from service would be considered deferred compensation under Section&nbsp;409A, then such deferred compensation amounts that would
otherwise be payable pursuant to this Plan and benefits that would otherwise be provided pursuant to this Plan, in each case, during the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">six-month</FONT> period immediately following the Eligible Executive&#8217;s
separation from service shall not be so paid or so provided until six months and one day after the date of the Eligible Executive&#8217;s separation from service, except as permitted under Section&nbsp;409A of the Code. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">7.4 Reimbursements . With respect to any amount of expenses eligible for reimbursement under this Plan that are considered deferred compensation under
Section&nbsp;409A, such expenses shall be reimbursed by the Employer within 60 days following the date on which the Employer receives the applicable invoice from the applicable Eligible Executive (and approves such invoice) but in no event later
than December 31st of the year following the year in which the Eligible Executive incurs the related expenses. In no event shall the reimbursements or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-kind</FONT> benefits to be provided by the Employer in one
taxable year affect the amount of reimbursements or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-kind</FONT> benefits to be provided in any other taxable year, nor shall an Eligible Executive&#8217;s right to reimbursement or
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">in-kind</FONT> benefits be subject to liquidation or exchange for another benefit. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">7.5 Separate Payments . Each payment
under this Plan shall be considered a &#8220;separate payment&#8221; and not one of a series of payments for purposes of Section&nbsp;409A. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">8.
<B><U>CLAIMS, INQUIRIES, APPEALS.</U></B> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">8.1 Applications for Benefits and Inquiries . Any application for benefits, inquiries about this Plan or
inquiries about present or future rights under this Plan must be submitted to the Plan Administrator in writing, as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Chief Human Resources
Officer </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(or General Counsel, if submitted by the Chief Human Resources Officer) </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">8.2 Denial of Claims . In the event that any application for benefits is denied in whole or in part, the
Plan Administrator must notify the applicant, in writing, of the denial of the application, and of the applicant&#8217;s right to review the denial. The written notice of denial will be set forth in a manner designed to be understood by the
employee, and will include specific reasons for the denial, specific references to the Plan provision upon which the denial is based, a description of any information or material that the Plan Administrator needs to complete the review, and an
explanation of this Plan&#8217;s review procedure. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This written notice will be given to the employee within 90 days after the Plan Administrator receives
the application, unless special circumstances require an extension of time, in which case, the Plan Administrator has up to an additional 90 days for processing the application. If an extension of time for processing is required, written notice of
the extension will be furnished to the applicant before the end of the initial <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">90-day</FONT> period. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This notice of
extension will describe the special circumstances necessitating the additional time and the date by which the Plan Administrator is to render his decision on the application. If written notice of denial of the application for benefits is not
furnished within the specified time, the application shall be deemed to be denied. The applicant will then be permitted to appeal the denial in accordance with the review procedure described below. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">8.3 Request for a Review . Any person (or that person&#8217;s authorized representative) for whom an application for benefits is denied (or deemed denied), in
whole or in part, may appeal the denial by submitting a request for a review to the Plan Administrator within 60 days after the application is denied (or deemed denied). The Plan Administrator will give the applicant (or his or her representative)
an opportunity to review pertinent documents in preparing a request for a review and submit written comments, documents, records and other information relating to the claim. A request for a review shall be in writing and shall be addressed to: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Chief Human Resources Officer </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(or General Counsel, if
submitted by the Chief Human Resources Officer) </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Versigent PLC </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5825 Innovation Drive </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Troy, Michigan 48098 </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">A request for review must set forth all of the grounds on which it is based, all facts in support of the request and any other matters that the applicant
feels are pertinent. The Plan Administrator may require the applicant to submit additional facts, documents or other material as it may find necessary or appropriate in making its review. </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">8.4 Decision on Review . The Plan Administrator will act on each request for review within 60 days after
receipt of the request, unless special circumstances require an extension of time (not to exceed an additional 60 days), for processing the request for a review. If an extension for review is required, written notice of the extension will be
furnished to the applicant within the initial <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">60-day</FONT> period. The Plan Administrator will give prompt, written notice of its decision to the applicant. In the event that the Plan Administrator confirms the
denial of the application for benefits in whole or in part, the notice will outline, in a manner calculated to be understood by the applicant, the specific Plan provisions upon which the decision is based. If written notice of the Plan
Administrator&#8217;s decision is not given to the applicant within the time prescribed in this Section&nbsp;8.4 , the application will be deemed denied on review. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">8.5 Rules and Procedures . The Plan Administrator may establish rules and procedures, consistent with this Plan and with ERISA, as necessary and appropriate
in carrying out its responsibilities in reviewing benefit claims. The Plan Administrator may require an applicant who wishes to submit additional information in connection with an appeal from the denial (or deemed denial) of benefits to do so at the
applicant&#8217;s own expense. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">8.6 Exhaustion of Remedies . No legal action for benefits under this Plan may be brought until the claimant (a)&nbsp;has
submitted a written application for benefits in accordance with the procedures described by Section&nbsp;8.1 , (b) has been notified by the Plan Administrator that the application is denied (or the application is deemed denied due to the Plan
Administrator&#8217;s failure to act on it within the established time period), (c) has filed a written request for a review of the application in accordance with the appeal procedure described in Section&nbsp;8.3 and (d)&nbsp;has been notified in
writing that the Plan Administrator has denied the appeal (or the appeal is deemed to be denied due to the Plan Administrator&#8217;s failure to take any action on the claim within the time prescribed by Section&nbsp;8.4 ). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9. <B><U>LEGAL FEES.</U></B> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9.1 If any contest or dispute
shall arise under or in connection with this Plan involving termination of an Eligible Executive&#8217;s employment while this Plan is in effect or involving the failure or refusal of the Employer or the Company to perform fully in accordance with
the terms of this Plan, and the Eligible Executive prevails in such contest or dispute with respect to substantially all of the material issues, then the Employer shall reimburse the Eligible Executive on a current basis for all reasonable legal
fees and related expenses, if any, incurred by the Eligible Executive in connection with such contest or dispute. </P>
</DIV></Center>
